captions.caption: A person uses a knife to slice off a strip from a cactus.
The knife continues down the cactus ridge, peeling back the skin.
A man in a blue shirt is seen harvesting the tall cactus.
The man positions his knife at the top of a cactus ridge.
He begins to slice a long strip from the side of the cactus.
The man continues his vertical cut along the cactus stem.
He carefully peels away a section of the outer cactus skin.
The man looks up as he continues to work on the plant.
He uses the knife to separate the skin from the inner flesh.
The man pulls a long strip of skin away with his fingers.
He uses the knife to detach the bottom of the skin strip.
The man starts cutting into another ridge of the cactus.
He slices downwards, following the natural curve of the plant.
The man uses his hand to pull the cut skin downwards.
He continues to harvest the outer layer of the cactus.
The man works on a section near the top of the cactus stem.
He makes precise cuts around the spines to avoid injury.
The man pulls a piece of the skin loose from the cactus.
He uses the knife to help peel the section away completely.
The man continues his harvesting work on the tall cactus.
He makes a series of short cuts to loosen the skin.
The man pulls a long, thin strip of cactus skin down.
He continues to use the knife to slice the outer layer.
The man reaches higher up to start a new cut.
He slices through the ridge, exposing the green interior.
The man peels a section of skin away from the cactus.
He uses the knife to separate the skin from the flesh.
The man continues the process on a different part of the stem.
He makes a horizontal cut to help remove a piece of skin.
The man pulls a piece of cactus skin away with his hand.
He starts a new slice on a remaining ridge of the cactus.
The man slices downwards, keeping the knife close to the skin.
He holds the cactus steady while he continues to cut.
The man works on another section of the outer skin.
He pulls a strip of skin that is partially detached.
The man uses the knife to finish detaching the skin strip.
He starts a new cut near the top of the cactus.
The man carefully slices through the thick outer layer.
He uses his thumb to peel back the top of the section.
The man continues to slice downwards with his knife.
He pulls the strip of skin away from the main stem.
The man uses the knife to free the remaining part of the strip.
He remarks on the dullness of his knife as he works.
He continues to harvest the cactus despite the knife's condition.
He makes another cut on one of the few remaining ridges.
The man pulls a larger section of skin downwards.
He uses the knife to saw through a thicker area of the skin.
The man continues working to detach the large section.
He pulls the final part of the skin away from the cactus.
The man holds the large piece of harvested cactus skin.
He pulls a piece of the cactus skin away.
The man holds the harvested section up to the camera.
He begins to trim the edges of the harvested piece.
The man speaks to the camera while preparing the cactus.
He uses his knife to shave off the spines from the skin.
The man continues cleaning the harvested section of cactus.
He holds the cleaned piece of cactus skin for display.
The man makes small cuts to remove any leftover spines.
He continues to refine the piece of cactus with his knife.
The man finishes the task and examines the prepared cactus.
